solution.text:
Let a be any real number.
limx→a⁡fx=limx→a⁡x=a2 (when x→a through rational values)
limx→a⁡fx=limx→a⁡2-x=2-a (when x→a through irrational values)
limx→a⁡fx will exist only when a2=2-a
i.e., when a=1,-2
Thus, if a≠1 or -2 then limx→a⁡fx will not exist
Hence, fx will be discontinuous at x=a where a≠1 or -2
